resources.string: Ayugram privacy features are being added here in stages.
Hide cloud-chat read receipts and typing indicators, and keep your account offline while enabled. Messages still become read locally; suppressed receipts are not replayed later.
Keep your account offline while using the app.
Do not send typing indicators in cloud chats.
Read messages locally without sending cloud-chat read receipts. Suppressed receipts are not sent later.
Keep previous text and captions before cloud-message edits or deletions. Disabled by default; secret and self-destructing messages are excluded.
Browse the locally saved versions of edited and deleted cloud messages.
No message history has been saved.
Delete all locally saved message history for this account?
Turn off optional animations, blur and autoplay for GIFs and videos. Change individual effects below.
Use simpler, square-cornered controls and disable Liquid Glass and interface blur. Other settings and chat features stay unchanged.
Up to 20 MiB across the bitmap, thumbnail, wallpaper and animation caches. This is not a total RAM limit. Requires restart; may cause more image decoding.
Skip prewarming the HTML widget engine at startup. Widgets still work when opened. Takes effect on next launch.
Messages, calls and notifications are not disabled. A smaller cache can trade memory for extra decoding; measure on your own device.
Hide your number in the local interface, for example during screen sharing. This does not change Telegram privacy settings.
Show the existing exteraGram action for saving a message to Saved Messages.

icegram is an independent, modified client based on exteraGram and Telegram for Android. Not an official Telegram or exteraGram release. Licensed under GPL; see LICENSE and ADDITIONAL_TERMS.md in the source.
Maps and location pickers are not included in icegram.
The exteraGram plugin engine is included. Only install plugins you trust: they run with the app’s permissions. Python and hooking increase the APK size.
